questions.prompt: A software pattern is best described as:

options.text: A reusable solution to a known problem in a well-defined context
A finished library you can import

questions.explanation: A pattern is a reusable solution to a known problem within a well-defined context, defined by context, problem (forces), and solution.

questions.prompt: In the GoF classification, which category does the Singleton pattern belong to?
questions.explanation: Singleton is a creational pattern, alongside Abstract Factory, Builder, Prototype, and Factory Method.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are GoF structural patterns?
questions.explanation: Adapter, Decorator, and Facade are structural patterns; Observer is behavioral.

questions.prompt: Which pattern embeds each behavioral variation inside an object passed as a parameter to an algorithm?
questions.explanation: Strategy embeds each variation in a strategy object implementing a common interface, passed to the algorithm (e.g. java.util.Comparator).

questions.prompt: The Template Method pattern defines the stable core of an algorithm and lets subclasses provide variations at specific points via abstract primitive operations.
questions.explanation: Template Method keeps a stable algorithm core that invokes abstract primitive operations overridden by subclasses (e.g. the Sorter/StringSorter example).

questions.prompt: Which Proxy variant creates expensive objects only on demand?
questions.explanation: A virtual proxy creates expensive objects on demand (e.g. slow-loading resources); a remote proxy is a local representative for an object in another address space.

questions.prompt: In the MVC pattern, which part should remain as separate as possible from the user interface?
questions.explanation: Application logic (the Model) must remain as separate as possible from the user interface (View = layout, Controller = events).

questions.prompt: Inheritance and composition are both ways to achieve reuse, but composition delegates requests to an included object.
questions.explanation: With inheritance the reusing class inherits methods directly; with composition it holds an included object and delegates client requests to it.

questions.prompt: Which type of pattern expresses a fundamental structural organization schema for entire software systems?
questions.explanation: Architectural patterns address system-wide structures; design patterns refine components; idioms are language-specific low-level patterns.
